messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — need to lock MVP scope for enterprise compliance asks from ACME and NovaPay. They both asked for audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SOC2 evidence, and flexible retention/export. We can't ship everything at once. Proposal: prioritize immutable per-tenant audit logs + retention/export MVP, ship KMS-managed key support (customer keys later). Opinions?

Anil Gupta: +1 for audit logs first. Audit trail is blocking for SOC2 readiness and it's lower infra risk than BYOK. BYOK requires key lifecycle, HSM/KMS compatibility, legal review.

Liam Patel: From infra POV, BYOK adds ops complexity (key import, rotation APIs, zero-knowledge owner). KMS-integrated (we manage keys) gets most customers over the bar and buys time. Also lets us validate audit log model in prod.

Sophie Rivera: Customers keep pushing for BYOK because of legal/reg constraints. But some will accept delegated KMS if we provide exportable evidence + strict key isolation per tenant. Can we offer a roadmap: "KMS-managed now, BYOK in next quarter with HSM support"? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

Tara Park: For product acceptance, we need clear launch criteria. Suggest MVP acceptance tests: 1) append-only audit log for all admin-level actions and model access events, 2) per-tenant retention policy with export (CSV/JSON) and deletion APIs, 3) audit log immutability with integrity hashes, 4) documentation + example queries for auditors.

Ben Ortiz: Engineering caveats: integrity hashes need storage of hash chain or signatures. Can do a Merkle-ish append hash in service. Export pipeline needs throttling. Also need RBAC review so audit events include `actor_id`, `route`, `model_id`, `input_masked` flags.

Anil Gupta: Security asks: we should include a minimal KMS facade that integrates with AWS KMS / GCP KMS for now. BYOK-specific flows: key import, zero access to plaintext by Redwood, key rotation, and attestation docs. MVP can be KMS-managed with per-tenant key material stored in cloud KMS namespaces.

Maya Chen: Good. How about timeline? If we scope MVP to: immutable audit logs + retention/export + KMS-managed tenant keys + docs, can eng deliver in 6 weeks? BYOK as a follow-up 8–12 weeks after MVP start (depends on legal).

Liam Patel: 6 weeks looks tight but doable if we limit logging surface: start with admin actions, model invocation metadata (no raw input storage by default), and workspace/admin API events. Avoid embedding full prompt content unless customer opts in.

Sophie Rivera: Sales note: communicate that BYOK is on roadmap and we'll offer a security playbook for auditors. Also offer an interim: per-tenant key separation and exportable audit bundles that include integrity proofs. That will placate a subset of customers.

Maya Chen: Draft MVP acceptance criteria (short):
- Audit log: append-only, immutable hashes, searchable by tenant/time/action (sample queries)
- Retention: default 365d, tenant override, export endpoint producing signed bundles
- KMS: integrate AWS/GCP KMS for tenant keys (Redwood manages keys, no BYOK in MVP)
- Docs: security guide + auditor bundle template
- Telemetry: surfaced in Console (per-route audit counts, size, errors)

Ben Ortiz: Add tests: replay protection (can't modify old entries), integrity verification script (deterministic), and load benchmarks for log write QPS. I'll open infra tickets.

Anil Gupta: Legal/GRC must review export format and metadata included. @Tara can you loop in GRC for privacy/data subject requests (DSR) compatibility?

Tara Park: On it — will sync with legal + GRC tomorrow. Also we need to confirm retention deletion guarantees (hard delete vs tombstone) for regulatory requests.

security-bot: Incident-bot: Note — prior incident #INC-2025-042 highlighted missing per-tenant export and made two customers escalate. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2025-042

Maya Chen: Action items:
- Ben: infra tickets for append-only store, integrity hashes, export pipeline (due EOW)
- Anil + Liam: KMS integration PRD + minimal API surface (due +10 business days)
- Tara: coordinate GRC/legal review (sync meeting invite)
- Sophie: customer comms draft and security playbook stub

Liam Patel: One more technical note: retention config example for the API: 
```
POST /v1/tenants/:id/retention
{
  "default_days": 365,
  "override": { "acme": 730 }
}
```

Sophie Rivera: I'll prepare a short customer FAQ saying: "BYOK is planned; initial privacy barriers addressed via per-tenant keys in supported KMS and signed audit bundles."

Maya Chen: OK — we'll ship MVP scope as discussed. If legal/GRC flags something major, we'll reprioritize. Thanks everyone, will follow up with a PRD link and timeline. :white_check_mark:
